description: Load this skill whenever the project contains static or interactive maps, embedded map widgets (Google Maps, Leaflet, Mapbox, OpenStreetMap), or any geographic visualizations. Under no circumstances embed a map without a text-based alternative conveying the same information. Absolutely always ensure map controls are keyboard-accessible and that all meaningful map content is available without the visual map.
